Nek'zali the Soulcoiler: [해제] Once the Essence Rend target reaches the edge of the room, help dispel it with Singe Magic. A Latent Cultist spawns where it was removed.
[제어] Stun a pack of Restless Amani with their Gravebound Advance shields still up for 3 sec with Shadowfury to delay them reaching the Soulcoil Well.
@m [차단] If you are on the well-kill team, interrupt Drowned Echo's Soulcoiler's Curse with your Felguard's Axe Toss.

Entombed Sentinels: [해제] Blighted Blood is a Magic effect, so help dispel it with Singe Magic.
[참고] The boss takes 99% less damage during Vitriolic Stasis, so hold Summon Demonic Tyrant until after the intermission.
[생존기] Shield yourself with Dark Pact before soaking Unstable Miasma.

Vashnik the Malignant: [우선 처치] AoE down the venom adds with Hand of Gul'dan and Implosion before they reach Malignant Cavity.
[제어] Burning Venom can be held with Fear until Hardened Venom. Damage may break it.
[해제] Dispelling Exploding Infection sets off Caustic Explosion, so use Singe Magic on one player at a time, staggered with the healers' dispels.

The Lost Explorers: [차단] Interrupt Scrollsage Iku's Icebound Flames with your Felguard's Axe Toss.
[해제] An Icebound Flames that lands after a missed interrupt is a Magic effect, so help dispel it with Singe Magic.
[위치] If you are the Blink Nova target, teleport with Demonic Circle or use Burning Rush to get away from the raid quickly.

Sszorak: [생존기] Sszorak takes 30% more damage during the 25 sec Dig In, so line up Summon Demonic Tyrant with it.
[분담] When soaking Mutilate, absorb the damage with Dark Pact.
[회피] Burning Rush keeps movement impairing effects from dropping you below normal speed, so you can dodge the whirlwinds even with Tempest slows stacked.

The Twin Fangs: [우선 처치] Kill the Venomous Emergence adds first with Hand of Gul'dan and Implosion.
[생존기] When soaking Ravenous Feast, absorb the damage with Dark Pact.
@m [차단] Interrupt Broodling of Ithraz's Visceral Burst with your Felguard's Axe Toss.

The Coiled Altar: [우선 처치] Ghastly Regeneration in the intermission makes Zul'jan take 100% more damage, so line up Summon Demonic Tyrant with it.
[차단] Once the Veil of Twilight shield breaks, interrupt Eternal Nightfall with your Felguard's Axe Toss.
[회피] After soaking Guillotine, teleport to a Demonic Circle placed 40 yards out to escape the axe.

Ula'tek: [우선 처치] Dump Summon Demonic Tyrant into the Venomous Heart exposed after Rage of the Shackled.
[차단] Interrupt Malice, Anguished Cry, and Vicious Echoes with your Felguard's Axe Toss.
[생존기] Line up Unending Resolve with the 20 sec of Rage of the Shackled raid damage and Fury Unleashed to reduce damage taken.

Nymrissa Wavecaller: [우선 처치] Kill the Bubblefin Shorerunners drawn in by Alluring Bubble with Implosion before they reach the bubble.
[생존기] Split Dark Pact and Unending Resolve across the raid damage from Pop! and Unending Tides.
@m [우선 처치] Waterfog Shield reduces damage to nearby murlocs by 99%, so kill the Bubblefin Frostscale before using Implosion.

Imperator Averzian: [차단] In the intermission, interrupt Pitch Bulwark from Shadowguard Stalwart and Voidbound Annihilator with your Felguard's Axe Toss.
[우선 처치] Kill the Voidmaws together with Hand of Gul'dan and Implosion.
[생존기] Line up Dark Pact with Dark Upheaval raid damage at the pull and after each intermission.

Vorasius: [해제] The Blisterburst damage taken increase and the Creep Spit slow are Magic effects, so help dispel them with Singe Magic.
[회피] Burning Rush keeps movement impairing effects from dropping you below normal speed, so even with Creep Spit slows stacked, run to the far end of the room opposite Void Breath.
[우선 처치] Kill the Blistercreeps gathered at the wall together with Implosion so Blisterburst breaks the Void Crystal.

Fallen-King Salhadaar: [차단] Interrupt Fractured Image's Shadow Fracture with your Felguard's Axe Toss.
@m [차단] If Fractured Images stripped of Nexus Shield are grouped, stun them together with Shadowfury to interrupt them.
[생존기] The boss takes 25% more damage during Entropic Unraveling, so line up Summon Demonic Tyrant with it and reduce raid damage taken by 25% with Unending Resolve.

Vaelgor & Ezzorak: [해제] Dread Breath fear is a Magic effect, so dispel affected players right away with Singe Magic.
[차단] Interrupt Voidbolt from the Voidorbs spawned after Void Howl with your Felguard's Axe Toss.
@m [제어] Stun Voidorbs that do not drift toward the raid even when interrupted together with Shadowfury when they are grouped in one spot.

Lightblinded Vanguard: [우선 처치] Right after the pull, line up Summon Demonic Tyrant on Commander Venel Lightblood, who takes 20% more damage from Avenging Wrath, and hit the group with Implosion.
[차단] Once Sacred Shield breaks, interrupt War Chaplain Senn's Blinding Light with your Felguard's Axe Toss.
[해제] The Avenger's Shield DoT is a Magic effect, so help dispel it with Singe Magic.

Crown of the Cosmos: [해제] Corrupting Essence on a player is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Singe Magic.
[위치] If you are targeted by Grasp of Emptiness, run far out of the circle with Burning Rush so Bursting Emptiness misses the raid.
@nh [차단] Interrupt Undying Voidspawn's Void Barrage with your Felguard's Axe Toss, or stun them together with Shadowfury.

Chimaerus the Undreamt God: [차단] Interrupt Haunting Essence's Fearsome Cry first with your Felguard's Axe Toss, and dispel any Fearsome Cry fear that slips through with Singe Magic.
@hm [해제] Once the Consuming Miasma target reaches an Alndust Essence pool, help dispel it with Singe Magic.
[우선 처치] If you are on the lower floor team, save Summon Demonic Tyrant to break the Alnshroud shield quickly.

Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar: [차단] Interrupt Light Eruption or Void Eruption from embers matching your feather color with your Felguard's Axe Toss.
[생존기] Save Summon Demonic Tyrant for the Phase 2 egg and use it during the Rebirth cast.
[분담] Shield yourself with Dark Pact before soaking Light Dive or Void Dive of your color together.

Midnight Falls: @nh [차단] Remove Safeguard stacks on a Safeguard Prism matrix with your Felguard's Axe Toss and Shadowfury.
@m [차단] Interrupt Terminate from your assigned Termination Matrix in order with your Felguard's Axe Toss.
[우선 처치] When the scattered Midnight Crystals are grouped, hit them together with Implosion to kill them before the cast finishes.

Rotmire: @hm [차단] Interrupt Sporecap's Poison Burst with your Felguard's Axe Toss.
[우선 처치] Kill the Bursting Shrooms at the stack spot with Implosion and Felstorm within 16 sec.
[위치] The Festering Vines target loses 30% movement speed, but Burning Rush keeps you from dropping below normal speed, so get to the edge of the room quickly.

note: There is no spec-specific source for each raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching ability tooltips to boss mechanics.
